name: devices
description: Device catalog read, device registration and rename on a fresh gateway: token gates, field and name validation, ChirpStack-backed registration for sensors and valves, re-registration and re-claim, EUI and lifecycle quirks of the catalog read, rich latest-data projection (watermark, chameleon, active actuation, rain day), and a rename that reaches ChirpStack (routes #10-#12).

body.name: row with a deliberately long name that exceeds the one hundred code point limit by exactly two characters!!

steps.why: Success path: the extended oracle carries the CHIRPSTACK_PROFILE_* mapping and the fuller gRPC stand-in, so the claim reaches ChirpStack (get miss, create, getKeys miss, createKeys) instead of the old 503 fail-closed refusal.
Re-registration by the same owner: UPDATE path, sync_version bump, ChirpStack device and keys already match so only get/getKeys run.
The device exists in ChirpStack now, so the rename drives setDeviceName (get + update) and the response reports chirpstack: updated instead of the old failed.
No change, no row write, no ChirpStack call: changed false and chirpstack skipped.
